title: Serverless in 60 seconds
caption: Serverless in 60 seconds: there are still servers, you just stop being the one who looks after them.

scenes.say: Running servers means patching them, guessing how many you need, and paying for them while they sit idle.
Serverless means you write a function, and the platform runs it when a request comes in.
There are still servers. They're just not your problem.

items.title: Scales
items.say: It scales from zero to thousands of requests on its own.

items.title: Per use
items.say: You pay for what actually runs.

items.title: Cold starts
items.text: the first call can be slower
items.say: The catch: the first request after a quiet spell can be slower.

scenes.say: That's serverless. Still servers, just not yours to babysit.
